clauses.reason: The order exempts G. Joseph Minetti, Member of the Civil Aeronautics Board, from mandatory retirement for age under subsection (c) of section 8335 of title 5 of the United States Code until October 31, 1977. The order recites his earlier exemption until September 30, 1977 by Executive Order No. 12006 of July 29, 1977, an earlier order that is not a later event for this order. The order is a single command with one fixed term, so its own stated date is the first end: 1977-10-31, recorded inclusive (the exemption runs through the end of that day); the exclusive reading, under which it ends when that day begins, is 1977-10-30. The order was signed 1977-09-30. Later events: Executive Order 12016 of 1977-10-31; Executive Order 12037 of 1978-01-31; Executive Order 12056 of 1978-04-28, each a further exemption of the same person with its own term, recorded as a later event and not as an end of this order. No amendment, revocation or shortening of this order is held (searched below).

research_rationale:
EO 12011 (signed 1977-09-30) is a one-person exemption under section 8335(c) of title 5, United States Code: G. Joseph Minetti, Member of the Civil Aeronautics Board, is exempted from mandatory retirement for age until October 31, 1977. The held Federal Register text of the order was read in full and is a single operative clause (the recital, the finding of public interest, and the exempting sentence). The order ends by its own terms on 1977-10-31 (inclusive; exclusive alternative 1977-10-30, owner ruling 2026-10-21 on until dates). Later events: Executive Order 12016 of 1977-10-31; Executive Order 12037 of 1978-01-31; Executive Order 12056 of 1978-04-28, each a further exemption of the same person with its own term, recorded as a later event and not as an end of this order. Searches judged adequate: U.S. Code and eCFR (no hit naming the order), the Office of the Federal Register disposition-note catalog, and a Cruden regex search of the held order texts for the person's surname, run by the producer, which found the chain members recorded above and nothing else. Whether the person left office on or before the stated date is not in any held source and is not asserted.

savings.reason: The exemption only suspended compulsory retirement for the stated term; it creates no continuing duty, office or rule. The person's service during the term and the pay for it had accrued by 1977-10-31; nothing in the order survives that date, and any later exemption is a separate grant recorded as a later event.
